messages:
Maya K: thinking out loud — we need a compact SLO->routing matrix that can be edited in Console and applied per-customer-tier+region. goal: automatic model-variant fallback when latency/availability SLOs are breached, but with quality/regression guards.
Jordan: +1. can you sketch the matrix? prefer a config snippet we can validate.
Maya K: sure, rough idea below (pseudo-config):
```yaml
routing_policies:
  - tier: free
    region: global
    latency_target_ms: 300
    availability_target_pct: 99
    circuit_breaker:
      error_rate_pct: 5
      sustained_window_s: 60
      open_backoff_s: 120
    fallback_order: ["small-quant", "small-8bit", "fallback-hosted"]
  - tier: enterprise
    region: eu
    latency_target_ms: 150
    availability_target_pct: 99.95
    circuit_breaker:
      error_rate_pct: 1
      sustained_window_s: 30
      open_backoff_s: 30
    fallback_order: ["small-quant", "medium-8bit", "same-arch-replicated"]
```
Liam: nit: error_rate_pct + latency breaches both should count. want composite signal: (p95>target OR err_rate>threshold) for sustained_window.
Anita: agree. also need a quality gate before swapping to quantized variant — we should run a quick eval set and abort fallback if LM quality drop > delta. otherwise enterprise customers will complain.
Jordan: how fast do we allow fallback? immediate or rate-limited? risk: noisy flaps.
Maya K: plan is to debounce: require sustained violation for sustained_window_s, then transition to fallback with a ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%) over N seconds, unless composition of signals says emergency open. also allow manual override in console.
deploy-bot: deploy noted for canary: routing-policy-service v3.4.1 -> staging (sha:abcd123).
Liam: telemetry checklist for SRE/Console: per-route p50/p95/p99, error_rate, fallback_rate, fallback_quality_delta, tokens_served, cost_estimate, region_capacity_utilization. need these as top-level panels.
Anita: +1. add a per-customer "fallback_success_rate" metric: fraction of fallbacks that still pass quality checks. if <90% trigger alert.
Jordan: question about quotas: when a fallback to a cheaper model happens, do we keep billing the same unit price? customers will expect cheaper model -> cheaper price OR we keep price but flag quality-impact. we need billing policy mapping.
Maya K: for now plan: billing unchanged during fallback for SLA-paying tiers, but show cost delta in Console and send invoice note. for free/dev tiers maybe auto-shift pricing (cheaper rate). open to product.
console-bot: Console feature request filed: #4672 - Routing Policy Matrix editor + dry-run preview + time-series overlay for selected metric.
Liam: UX idea: dry-run should show expected fallback rate and projected latency/cost change using recent 1h traffic. avoids surprises.
Anita: for rollout UX: allow canary by customer list or percentage of traffic, plus an automated rollback if fallback_quality_delta > 2% for enterprise.
Jordan: API design: would prefer a single POST /routing-policies with schema v1 that includes validation hooks and dry_run=true flag. backend returns diagnostics + sample decisions for 1k recent requests.
Maya K: backend will need efficient simulation path. we'll reuse the smart-router decision engine in 'simulate' mode. cost: simulated KV cache warm/cold approximations — include confidence score.
Liam: ops concern: region-specific capacity; if APAC is overloaded, default to region_fallback_policy that prefers nearby region (sg -> eu) only for enterprise, not free. need blackout/exclusion lists too.
Anita: action items: Maya to iterate config schema + validation rules; Jordan to prototype API + simulator endpoint; Liam to add telemetry panels + alerts; I'll draft eval-runbook for quantized fallbacks.
Maya K: sounds good. tagging @Jordan @Liam @Anita — let's sync tomorrow 10am PT.
Jordan: will bring basic API stub.
Liam: will add Grafana panel PR.
Anita: will prepare a short checklist for support and comms (what to tell customers during fallback).
Maya K: thanks all :thumbsup:
